title: Setlist backup
description: Generate a JSON object following this schema for import into the setlist app. Return JSON only. Song IDs must be unique positive integers; the array order is the set order. Do not invent chord charts: use only information provided by the user. An import replaces the existing set.

songs.description: Songs in set order. Every song must have a different id.

midiChannel.description: MIDI channel shared by songs; defaults to 1.

callSheetFontSize.description: Call-sheet text size in pixels; defaults to 16.

id.description: Unique within this set; use 1, 2, 3, etc.

subtitle.description: Artist or arrangement; use an empty string if unknown.

rigNote.description: Guitar or rig notes; use an empty string if unknown.

key.description: Tonic of the chord chart as a major-key note, without a mode suffix.

notes.description: General guitar notes; use an empty string if none.

sections.description: Call-sheet sections in performance order. Use an empty array when no chart is available.

midi.description: Optional per-song MIDI program change and controller message. MIDI BPM is taken from the song's bpm.

chords.description: Bars in the song's key, separated by |, e.g. C | F | G | C. Use ||: and :|| for repeat markers. Use an empty string if unknown.

midi.description: Use raw MIDI values 0–127. Set both cc and ccValue together, or leave both null/absent.
